identity.name: Dodecyl gallate
identity.chemical_class: Alkyl gallate (gallic acid ester), synthetic phenolic antioxidant

function.mechanism: Phenolic chain-breaking antioxidant activity that slows lipid oxidation in fat-containing foods.
common_food_categories: Chewing-gum-related EU category context in 2018 follow-up legal text

adi.basis: EFSA 2015 re-evaluation abstract indicates insufficient data to complete assessment and that the previous group ADI should no longer be considered valid.

efsa.key_finding: EFSA reported no concern at reported use levels in the assessed context but also insufficient reproductive/developmental data for full safety confirmation and ADI support; EU follow-up applied strong restrictions.

adi.basis: JECFA entry for dodecyl gallate lists NO ADI ALLOCATED; temporary ADI from 1993 was not extended.

notable_bans: EU follow-up Regulation (EU) 2018/1481 documented unresolved EFSA data gaps and removed/limited uses for E312 in the Union list framework.

concerns.summary: A 2021 review of synthetic phenolic antioxidants (including lauryl gallate) reports high-dose animal toxicity concerns (including DNA-damage/cancer-relevant signals) at class level.
In vitro melanoma-cell evidence shows dodecyl gallate can induce oxidative stress and apoptosis-related pathways at experimental concentrations.
Regulatory uncertainty remains material: EFSA re-evaluation reported insufficient data for complete safety assessment and invalidated support for the previous group ADI.

no_concern_confirmed: EFSA abstract also reports no safety concern for the then-reported uses and use levels.
No IARC Group 1/2A/2B/3 listing for dodecyl/lauryl gallate was identified in checked IARC classification resources.
A 2018 in vivo/in vitro therapeutic-model paper reported low toxicity in tested systems, though this is not a chronic dietary safety dataset.

populations: High consumers in jurisdictions where use remains legally possible
adi_exceedance.notes: Classical ADI exceedance cannot be robustly quantified because EFSA did not support a valid current group ADI and JECFA lists no ADI allocated.

risk_assessment.rationale: Despite some jurisdiction-specific permitted uses, EFSA's latest re-evaluation for E312 identified unresolved data gaps and did not support continued validity of the previous group ADI, followed by strong EU restriction/removal measures. This places E312 above a moderate caveat profile.
key_factors: EFSA 2015: insufficient reproductive/developmental data for complete assessment
EFSA: prior group ADI support not maintained
US allowance is narrow and use-specific (21 CFR 166.110(b)(5))
JECFA status is NO ADI ALLOCATED
